task_completion.description: Navigate to the Email Templates configuration section in Odoo.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The screen shows the 'Email Templates' list view or a creation form within the Settings/Technical or CRM configuration menu.

task_completion.description: Set the template name to 'Opportunity Follow-Up' and the model to 'Lead/Opportunity' (crm.lead).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Template Name' field contains 'Opportunity Follow-Up' and the 'Applies to' or 'Model' field shows 'Lead/Opportunity' or 'crm.lead'.

task_completion.description: Set the email subject with the required placeholder.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Subject' field contains the text 'Following up: {{ object.name }}'.

task_completion.description: Include the partner name placeholder, opportunity name placeholder, and required phrases in the body.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The email body editor shows: '{{ object.partner_id.name }}', '{{ object.name }}', 'Thank you for your interest', and 'Best regards'.
The UI shows the template in a 'Saved' state (e.g., 'Edit' button appears instead of 'Save', or a breadcrumb/notification confirms the record is created).

integrity.description: The agent used the Odoo graphical user interface rather than executing database queries or scripts via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse cursor movements, clicks on Odoo buttons, and text being typed into form fields.

integrity.description: The agent did not bypass the creation process by simply searching for an existing template with the same name.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence of screenshots shows the 'New' or 'Create' button being clicked and the form being filled manually.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the live Odoo application elements.
integrity.visual_evidence: The URL bar shows the expected Odoo domain and the UI elements (dropdowns, save icons) respond to agent actions.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The template name must be exactly 'Opportunity Follow-Up'. The model must be 'crm.lead' (often displayed as 'Lead/Opportunity'). The subject must be 'Following up: {{ object.name }}'. The body must contain four specific strings: '{{ object.partner_id.name }}', '{{ object.name }}', 'Thank you for your interest', and 'Best regards'.
